title: scriptspect configuration
description: Cross-platform script analysis configuration. Place in a `scriptspect` field of package.json or in scriptspect.config.json.

targets.description: Target shells to analyze against. Defaults to npm's script shells: posix-sh + cmd.

severity.description: Per-rule severity overrides. Changing a rule to 'advisory' keeps it visible but never fails CI.

ignore.description: Suppress findings. Within one entry, every specified key must match (package globs AND script globs AND rule ids). Prefer narrow entries over broad ones.

packages.description: Package path globs relative to the root (e.g. 'packages/web/package.json', 'examples/**').
